most common epigenetic modifications and plays a key role in chromatin remodeling and gene expression regulation． Studies have shown that changes in the sites and levels of histone acetylation are observed during liver fibrosis． Histone acetylation is regulated by histone acetyltransferase ( HAT ) and histone deacetylase ( HDAC) ． Imbalance of HAT and HDAC can cause pathojulogical changes． Many studies have investigated the role of HAT and HDAC in the initiation and progression of liver fi-brosis． This article reviews the recent research on histone acetylation in liver fibrosis in order to provide new perspectives and targets for the pathological mechanism of liver fibrosis and the development of related therapeutic drugs．Key words: histone acetylation;liver fibrosis;hepatic stellate cells;histone acetyltransferase;histone deacetylase;
